# EditorFrame

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:editor-frame` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

A bounded editor surface with a fixed toolbar and one native source or preview scroll owner.

## When to use

Own a framed or embedded writing surface while the app owns its native textarea, draft, and rendered preview.

- A standalone Markdown or text editor needs a fixed toolbar above a bounded native textarea or preview.
- An embedded editor needs the same source/preview anatomy without a second frame.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for an ordinary single form field; use TextField.
- Do not replace the app's draft, recovery, focus, or preview behavior.

**Alternatives:**

- [TextField](./text-field.md) (nearest) — Use TextField for a conventional form value without editor toolbar and preview.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/editor-frame` — exports `EditorFrame`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/editor-frame` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/editor-frame.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/editor-frame`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuieditor-frame) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- source and preview modes
- framed and embedded appearances
- padded and flush insets
- expanded overlay
- embedded autosize or restored source height

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [Toolbar](./toolbar.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** draft value; editing actions; preview rendering; recovery and focus management.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Give the editor frame a label when it is a distinct region; the app labels its native textarea and supplies toolbar controls.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-editor-frame`, `kui-editor-frame__toolbar`, `kui-editor-frame__surface`.

Never put `kui-editor-frame`, `kui-editor-frame__toolbar`, `kui-editor-frame__surface` on an element you write; render `EditorFrame` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-normal`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-radius-l`, `--kui-shadow-l`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
